definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: SHA-256 fingerprint of the event lifecycle and time fields consumed by this policy.
definitions.triggerPredicate: Event is active and startTime <= serverNow < endTime.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: Event is cancelled or serverNow >= endTime.
definitions.permissionPredicate: Caller is a canonical manager of the event organizer.
definitions.readinessReason: Event lifecycle and schedule are canonical server-owned facts.

definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: SHA-256 fingerprint of waitlistedCount, admission policy, capacity, and event schedule.
definitions.triggerPredicate: Active event ends in the future, starts inside the Today horizon, has waitlistedCount > 0, and is not a manual-approval admission flow.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: Waitlisted count reaches zero, event leaves the horizon, event ends, or event is cancelled.
definitions.permissionPredicate: Caller is a canonical manager of the event organizer.
definitions.dueAtPolicy: Event startTime minus 24 hours. A newly discovered overdue item retains this original deadline.
definitions.readinessReason: Waitlist count and admission policy are canonical event projections.

definitions.sourceIdPolicy: Canonical event id grouping pending manual-approval participation edges.
definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: SHA-256 fingerprint of the sorted pending participation ids, request timestamps, and event schedule.
definitions.triggerPredicate: An active request-to-join event starts inside the Today horizon and has one or more waitlisted participation edges with hostApprovalStatus pending.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: Every request is approved, declined, cancelled, or otherwise leaves pending; or the event ends or is cancelled.
definitions.permissionPredicate: Caller is a canonical manager of the event organizer.
definitions.dueAtPolicy: Earliest pending request time plus 24 hours.
definitions.readinessReason: Manual approval is explicit on both the event policy and canonical participation workflow edge.

definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: Application revision converted to a stable string.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: Review status becomes approved, waitlisted, declined, or withdrawn.
definitions.permissionPredicate: Caller is a canonical manager of the application organizer.
definitions.expiresAtPolicy: No action expiry while the canonical review status remains open.
definitions.readinessReason: Application review status is an explicit callable-owned workflow state.

definitions.sourceIdPolicy: Latest terminal provider sync run for an organizer and event.
definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: Latest terminal run id plus inputHash, status, and completion time.
definitions.triggerPredicate: The latest terminal provider sync run for the event is partial or failed; a running retry does not hide the unresolved terminal result.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: A newer terminal sync run for the event completes successfully or the source expires.
definitions.permissionPredicate: Caller is a canonical manager of the provider connection organizer.
definitions.dueAtPolicy: Latest failed or partial run completion time, otherwise start time.
definitions.readinessReason: Provider sync run status is explicit, bounded, and server-owned.

definitions.sourceIdPolicy: Latest terminal automation run for an enabled organizer, form, rule, and current rule revision.
definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: Latest terminal run id plus rule revision, status, and update time.
definitions.triggerPredicate: The latest terminal run for the current revision of an enabled form rule is partiallyFailed or failed; a running retry does not hide the unresolved terminal result.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: A newer terminal run for the same current form-rule revision succeeds, or the rule is revised, disabled, or removed.
definitions.permissionPredicate: Caller is a canonical manager of the form organizer.
definitions.expiresAtPolicy: No action expiry while it remains the latest run for an active rule.
definitions.readinessReason: Automation run status is explicit and server-owned.

definitions.sourceIdPolicy: Organizer owner uid plus the currency-selected payout provider.
definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: Fingerprint of organizer owner, paid-event schedule, provider, onboarding status, and payout capability fields.
definitions.triggerPredicate: A paid active event starts inside the Today horizon and the organizer owner's required provider account is missing, restricted, or not charge-and-payout enabled.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: The required owner account is fully enabled, all paid events leave the horizon, or the organizer ownership changes.
definitions.permissionPredicate: Caller is a canonical organizer manager; payout setup remains owner-only at the destination.
definitions.dueAtPolicy: Earliest paid event startTime minus 72 hours. A newly discovered overdue item retains this original deadline.
definitions.readinessReason: Organizer ownership, paid-event currency, and provider account capability are explicit server facts.

definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: Local expected attendance revision plus retry state.
definitions.triggerPredicate: A local attendance operation is retryable, conflicted, or older than its review threshold.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: The server accepts the absolute attendance mutation or the host explicitly resolves or discards it.
definitions.permissionPredicate: Current signed-in host owns the local outbox entry and retains event attendance authority.
definitions.dueAtPolicy: Immediate for conflict, otherwise the local retry or seven-day review threshold.
definitions.readinessReason: The outbox is intentionally local-only and must be merged after the server projection is fetched.

definitions.sourceIdPolicy: Source event id when selected, otherwise organizer shortcut identity.
definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: Rehearsal sourceEventRevision compared with the current safe event snapshot fingerprint.
definitions.triggerPredicate: Never inferred as mandatory attention; Today exposes it as an explicit preparation shortcut.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: Not applicable to the attention queue.
definitions.permissionPredicate: Caller is a canonical organizer manager.
definitions.expiresAtPolicy: Rehearsal session expiry is independent of the shortcut.
definitions.dedupePolicy: Not persisted as an attention item.
definitions.readinessReason: Rehearsal is available without pretending every event requires one.

definitions.triggerPredicate: Requires an explicit preparation readiness state and blocker vocabulary; plan status setup alone does not mean incomplete.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: Future explicit readiness state becomes ready.
definitions.dueAtPolicy: Future policy derived from event start.
definitions.readinessReason: The plan has lifecycle state but no explicit complete preparation checklist or readiness projection.

definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: Future explicit layout requirement and selected layout revision.
definitions.triggerPredicate: Requires an explicit event-format or playbook declaration that a room layout is mandatory.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: A required compatible layout is selected and current.
definitions.dueAtPolicy: Future policy derived from event start.
definitions.readinessReason: A null optional layout is not proof that the event requires one.

definitions.sourceIdPolicy: Event id plus future staffing requirement revision.
definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: Future required-role policy revision plus active grant revisions.
definitions.triggerPredicate: Requires an explicit required staffing plan; zero grants alone is not an error.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: All declared required roles have active unexpired grants.
definitions.permissionPredicate: Canonical organizer manager; staff cannot expand their own grants.
definitions.dueAtPolicy: Future policy derived from event start.
definitions.readinessReason: Grant existence does not express how many staff, if any, an event requires.

definitions.sourceIdPolicy: Form response id plus future workflow revision.
definitions.triggerPredicate: Requires form-level requiresReview policy and response-level review status.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: Future response review status becomes terminal.
definitions.permissionPredicate: Canonical organizer manager with active response data access.
definitions.dueAtPolicy: Future form workflow SLA from submittedAt.
definitions.readinessReason: Submission is not equivalent to needing review, and generic responses have no review workflow today.

definitions.sourceIdPolicy: Organizer thread id plus future attention revision.
definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: Future explicit reply-required or triage revision.
definitions.triggerPredicate: Requires an explicit replyRequired, assigned, snoozed, or resolved workflow state.
definitions.resolutionPredicate: Future thread attention state becomes resolved or snoozed beyond the horizon.
definitions.permissionPredicate: Canonical organizer manager with authorized sanitized thread access.
definitions.dueAtPolicy: Future inbox SLA from explicit attention opening.
definitions.expiresAtPolicy: Thread retention expiry or explicit resolution.
definitions.readinessReason: Last inbound or unread is not proof that a human reply is required.

definitions.sourceIdPolicy: Event id plus future reconciliation revision.
definitions.sourceRevisionPolicy: Future explicit reconciliation version over attendance, refunds, reports, and provider coverage.
definitions.triggerPredicate: Requires an explicit post-event reconciliation policy and unresolved blocker set.
definitions.readinessReason: Counts alone cannot prove whether attendance, refunds, provider imports, and reporting are reconciled.
